newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar backs off highs after rally.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar backs off highs after rally.

text.p: White sugar futures backed off their earlier highs in solid volume on Tuesday as players took profits after the rally inspired by the raws market ran its course, traders said.
Shortly after the New York open, fund buying pushed the spot March contract 19 points higher to hit 11.05 cents/lb and the sudden strength dragged London values along.
"It (London) has gone up on the back of the funds in New York...it's lively and decent volume," said one trader.
But then players took profits at the higher levels and London's December and March contracts both slipped back on scale-down selling, as did the nearby March/March premium against New York.
Traders also reported crosses boosting the overall volume and interest to trade the December/March and December/May spreads at around $4.00 and wider.
At 1554 GMT December stood 50 cents firmer at $322.70 after touching a high of $325.00. March was up $1.20 at $319.50, $2.00 below its intraday high, and total market volume was 2,405 lots.
A similar pattern could be seen in Paris where volume reached 1,243 lots. December was down 20 cents at $322.00 and March up $1.30 at $320.00.
